name: Scenario
shortDescription: Game art generation. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Scenario generates art aimed at games. The free plan includes 50 daily credits. Paid plans start at $15 per month.
bestFor: Game-specific image styles and asset sets
Art pipelines that want a free plan to start
notIdealFor: 3D mesh generation (see Meshy for that job)
A generation test, which is not described here
strength: The free plan includes 50 credits per day for game art, and the paid plan starts at $15 per month.
weakness: It generates images and style sets, not 3D meshes.

useCaseFit.make-images: Draws game art from a prompt.
